# Getting help

Start with the [README](../README.md) for launch commands and controls. Run `uv run jev-robot-web --offline` to check the local demo before investigating a model API problem.

Use [Discussions](https://github.com/arterialist/jev-robot/discussions) for setup questions and experiment ideas. Include your OS, Python version, and launch command. Say whether the model loops are live or offline. For robot behavior questions, include the selected motor mode and active self-thought.

Use a [bug report](https://github.com/arterialist/jev-robot/issues/new/choose) for reproducible defects. Include logs or a recording when they help explain the failure. Remove credentials and private provider responses first.

Follow [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md) for vulnerabilities and exposed keys.
